dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [He sets the slate down and opens his mouth for the first time since you met him.]

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: My case has been called. Below, I expect. I earned it.

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: But I go with a lighter conscience than I arrived with. That is your doing. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Brother Tallow
dialogue.text: [He bows, and the silence he leaves behind is gentler than the one he kept.]
